notes.title: Let's Play... Darkest Valley Demo - Developer Live Stream Thursday
notes.content:
For the Steam Autumn Games Festival, we're releasing a demo of Darkest Valley!

We'll showcase the melee fighter class as we work through the 7 quests in our upcoming ARPG demo.

In this live stream, we'll talk about some of the different item builds, play styles, and the future content we'll be including in the full game to be released Spring next year. We'll also be around to answer any questions you might have, perhaps from your own playthroughs of the demo.

During the event, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/k98GnNv]Discord[/url] channel's #general channel to ask questions live!
